# Ahton

> Ahton is a VS Code extension for Windows x64. It shows a desktop popup when Claude Code or Codex CLI finishes or needs input in a VS Code terminal, and clicking the popup focuses the right VS Code window and terminal. Popup text is fixed and never contains prompts, replies or paths. It makes no network requests.

Install: VS Code Marketplace `kidneys3.ahton`, Open VSX `kidneys3/ahton`, or `code --install-extension kidneys3.ahton`. After install, run the command "Ahton: Configure Claude Code and Codex".

Not supported: macOS, Linux, VS Code chat, the ChatGPT desktop app, terminals outside VS Code.
